Bai2009 and MoonWeidner2015 provide the regular homogeneous IFE benchmark; this is chiefly a sanity embedding.

soundness_flags.label: ass:left-support-orthogonality; ass:right-support-orthogonality; ass:left-score-orthogonality; ass:right-score-orthogonality
soundness_flags.one_line: Exact orthogonality of binary treatment/post supports and heterogeneous scores to latent loadings and factors is load-bearing yet not plausibly implementable in the claimed block-adoption setting; calling latent loadings “measured” does not establish applicability.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies finite-rank perturbations of rectangular random matrices and their extreme singular values/vectors.
Under stated assumptions, the limiting distribution is invariant to fitting at least the true number of factors.
The paper reports bias and size distortion under weak factors and proposes bias-aware uniformly valid confidence intervals.
Factor-structured treatment-effect heterogeneity can make IFE fail to recover ATT through absorption, while methods excluding treated post-treatment observations avoid that mechanism.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of the American Statistical Association 116(536) (2021), 1746--1763
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The published article concerns tall-wide imputation, counterfactual treatment effects, and normal-distribution theory; no formula-level comparison was asserted from the inaccessible primary text.
The result concerns variance-weighted treatment-effect limits for Bai IFE and related estimators with a growing estimated factor count.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the four exact latent-orthogonality restrictions with an observable residualization construction and explicit approximation-rate terms; then rederive the profile and masked-Wald claims under that condition.

Add a theorem that compares full-sample IFE, Bai--Ng tall-wide imputation, and a second named counterfactual estimator on a common non-oracle class, with an explicit condition under which their ATT targets diverge.
Give a worked finite nondegenerate panel instance that computes the profile, exhibits an absorbed point, and shows the masked/full-sample contrast directly from observable primitives.

recommended_next_step: Revise the oracle orthogonality regime into an implementable or explicitly justified design class before advancing to Stage 0.
